papers.title: The Exact MMS Guarantees of EFX and PMMS
papers.titleZh: EFX 和 PMMS 的精确 MMS 保证
papers.abstract: Envy-freeness up to any good (EFX) and pairwise maximin share (PMMS) are standard local fairness criteria for indivisible goods, whereas maximin share (MMS) is a global benchmark. We determine the exact quantitative relationship between these local fairness notions and the global MMS guarantee under nonnegative additive valuations. We show that the optimal universal factor for both notions is $ρ^{\mathrm{EFX}\to\mathrm{MMS}}=ρ^{\mathrm{PMMS}\to\mathrm{MMS}}=\frac{10}{17}$. We prove the lower bound by a combinatorial charging argument. After an initial reduction, both EFX and PMMS imply the same local condition on every foreign bundle from the perspective of a focal agent: deleting its least valuable good leaves value at most the focal bundle. A three-piece concave weight function translates this local condition into the global $10/17$ guarantee. We then construct an explicit family of complete allocations that are simultaneously PMMS and EFX$_0$, whose MMS ratios converge to $10/17$, showing that both constants are tight even in the presence of zero-valued goods. The argument also gives $α$-EFX $\Rightarrow (10α/17)$-MMS. Finally, we establish an exact correspondence between these fair-division guarantees and scheduling equilibria. For every fixed number of agents $n$, the EFX-to-MMS extremal ratio equals the reciprocal of the pure price of anarchy for selfish identical-machine covering. Similarly, the PMMS-to-MMS ratio equals the reciprocal of a locality gap based on exact pairwise machine repartition. These correspondences explain why the constant $10/17$ governs both problems.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 在不可分物品分配中，全局公平标准如最大最小份额（MMS）难以实现，因此研究者转向局部公平准则如 EFX 和 PMMS。问题是：这些局部准则能在多大程度上保障全局 MMS？此前研究给出了近似下界与上界，但最优常数仍未知，尤其是 PMMS 是否比 EFX 提供更强的 MMS 保证也不清楚。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 模型考虑 n 个代理人和一组不可分物品，每个代理人具有非负加性估值。分配是一个物品划分。EFX 要求移除任意一个正价值物品后无嫉妒，PMMS 要求任意两人间都能通过最优二分获得至少其二人 MMS。MMS 则是代理人在将所有物品分为 n 份中最差一份所能保证的最大值。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文证明 EFX 和 PMMS 分配均能保证 10/17 ≈ 0.588 的 MMS，且该因子是紧的。尽管 PMMS 在局部上强于 EFX，但它并未带来更高的最坏情况 MMS 保证。此外，作者建立了公平分配与机器覆盖调度之间的精确对应关系，解释了为何 10/17 成为共同临界值。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 作者采用组合计费论证，构造了一个三段凹权重函数，将局部条件转化为全局下界。通过证明满足局部约束的外邦束总权重不超过 1，而任何超过 17/10 的 MMS 基准束权重至少为 1，导出矛盾。同时构造显式实例族逼近 10/17，并利用调度游戏中的纯价格均衡与局部间隙建立等价性。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 结果依赖于非负加性估值假设，且紧性构造涉及零值物品和复杂参数化结构，可能限制实际应用。然而，论文的价值在于揭示了不同公平概念间的深层联系，提供了紧确界证明的新方法，并打通了公平分配与调度理论之间的桥梁，特别适合关注理论边界与跨领域对应的读者深入研读。

papers.title: Residual Maximin Share: Exact Finite-Agent Frontier, Sparse Extremizers, and Threshold Cuts
papers.titleZh: 剩余最大最小份额：精确的有限代理边界、稀疏极值实例与阈值割
papers.abstract: Residual maximin share (RMMS) is the largest share threshold that remains guaranteeable throughout dynamic allocation processes, even after previously allocated, lower-valued bundles are removed from the item pool. For additive valuations, recent density-balance analyses established finite-agent lower bounds comparing RMMS with the classical maximin share (MMS). In this paper, we prove that these finite-agent lower bounds are exact. Specifically, if $d_n$ denotes the largest odd integer at most $n$, the worst-case ratio satisfies $\inf_{M,v:\operatorname{MMS}>0}\frac{\operatorname{RMMS}(M,v,n)}{\operatorname{MMS}(M,v,n)}=\frac{2d_n}{3d_n-1}$. Consequently, the exact additive frontier forms consecutive odd-even plateaus and converges monotonically to $2/3$. We then investigate the combinatorial structure of extremal instances. While naive witnesses require $Θ(n^2)$ items, we construct an explicit three-valued family achieving the exact boundary with only linear support: $(5n-3)/2$ items for odd $n$ and $(5n-4)/2$ items for even $n$. Its low-valued block supports two exact partitions that simultaneously certify the MMS benchmark and the residual obstruction. By modeling these dual partitions as a bipartite transportation graph, we prove that this block attains the absolute minimum support $q+d-1=3q$. At minimum support, any two-valued filler is uniquely rigid up to relabeling. Finally, we establish structural characterizations of RMMS. A general min--max representation applies to all finite monotone valuations. For integer additive valuations, we prove that a threshold $T$ is residual self-feasible if and only if every subset cut satisfies a packing-covering condition. Because RMMS is pointwise maximal among residual self-feasible shares, these exact constants establish a tight limitation on the fairness guarantees achievable by share-based lone-divider algorithms.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 动态公平分配中，传统最大最小份额（MMS）无法应对物品被逐步移除的情形。当先前分配的低价值捆绑被拿走后，剩余物品可能不足以保障后续代理人的MMS。本文聚焦于残差最大最小份额（RMMS）的精确边界问题，旨在回答：RMMS与MMS之间的最坏比值是否达到已知下界的紧性，以及是否存在更简洁的极值实例。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 模型考虑n个代理人分配不可分物品，每个代理人具加性估值函数。RMMS定义为在任意k个低于该阈值的捆绑被移除后，剩余物品仍可划分为n−k个不低于该阈值的捆绑的最大可能值。研究关注RMMS与MMS的比值下界是否精确，并构造极小支持集的三值物品实例来验证这一边界。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文证明了RMMS/MMS的下界是精确的，即对于任意n≥2，最坏情况下的比值恰好为λₙ=2dₙ/(3dₙ−1)，其中dₙ是不超过n的最大奇数。该比值呈现奇偶平台现象并单调收敛至2/3。此外，构造出仅含线性数量物品的稀疏极值实例，打破了此前二次项数量的需求。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 作者通过构造双重重整划分来同时认证MMS基准与残差障碍：一是将低值块划分为d个价值q的捆绑，二是划分为q个价值d的捆绑。利用互素性质建立二部运输图，证明最小支持规模为q+d−1=3q，并结合极小性与唯一性分析得出结构刚性结论。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 结果局限于加性估值和静态极值构造，未提供通用算法实现路径。证明依赖特定数值结构（如d=2q+1），推广至一般情形可能存在难度。最值得阅读的是其极小支持构造与运输图分析技巧，这对理解动态公平机制的设计极限具有深刻启示。

papers.title: Test-time Reinforcement Learning in Imperfect Information Games
papers.titleZh: 不完美信息游戏中的测试时强化学习
papers.abstract: Test-time reasoning has significantly improved performance in domains ranging from games to language models. However, test-time policy changes with formal guarantees on the performance of the resulting strategy remain a challenge in two-player zero-sum imperfect-information games. Existing solutions are limited to tabular methods or single gradient step updates. In this work, we investigate policy-gradient algorithms as a method for scalable test-time reasoning. We extend the concept of gadget game, tabular technique for test-time search, to the reinforcement learning setting. Unlike prior approaches, we represent the gadget game implicitly by modified sampling and neural policy rather then explicitly by constructing it, thereby removing constraints on subgame size. Furthermore, we formally prove that, unlike prior tabular algorithms, regularized policy-gradient algorithms limit possible strategy degradation caused by test-time reasoning, even without the gadget games. Our evaluation across small- and large-scale games confirms that additional test-time training often substantially improves performance relative to the blueprint strategy.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 在不完美信息博弈中，玩家无法观测真实状态，需基于信念进行决策。传统测试时推理方法受限于显式子博弈构造，难以扩展到大规模游戏。现有方法要么依赖表格化求解，要么仅允许单步更新，限制了性能提升潜力。本文旨在解决如何在保持策略安全性的前提下，实现可扩展的测试时策略优化。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 文章采用两方零和随机博弈（FOSG）框架，引入行为策略与信息集建模信息不对称。通过子博弈求解机制，在每个决策点动态重构局部博弈。关键创新是隐式表示‘gadget game’，利用临时神经网络模拟对手的历史策略选择，并结合带正则化的策略梯度算法进行优化，避免显式枚举子博弈状态。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 本文提出一种无需显式构造子博弈的测试时推理方法，首次将gadget game思想推广至深度强化学习场景。理论上证明，固定磁体策略下的正则化策略梯度能限制策略退化。实验表明，该方法在小规模游戏中有效降低可利用性，在大型Battleship游戏中相较基线策略取得超过80%胜率。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 核心技术包括隐式gadget game建模、基于Transformer的信念生成模型与固定磁体正则化训练。通过引入临时actor网络模拟对手的虚拟历史选择，规避显式子博弈构建。信念模型自回归生成符合当前信息集的状态路径，支持高效采样。理论分析借助Bregman散度与Jensen-Shannon散度刻画策略变化边界。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 方法仍需每次对局后重置参数以防止全局策略污染，限制了长期经验积累。此外，理论保证主要针对序列形式策略，应用于行为策略时为经验有效。最值得阅读的是其将经典博弈论安全推理机制与现代深度强化学习融合的设计思路，为测试时搜索提供了新范式。

papers.title: Constrained Fair Allocations via Partition Matroid Reductions
papers.titleZh: 通过划分拟阵约减实现受约束的公平分配
papers.abstract: We study fair allocation of indivisible goods under additive valuations and matroid constraints. A challenging open question is whether a complete and feasible envy-free up to one good (EF1) allocation exists under every matroid that admits a complete and feasible allocation. The state-of-the-art result by Biswas and Barman [2018] positively resolves this question for partition matroids. Our first result positively resolves it for laminar matroids, which generalize partition matroids, when there are three agents. Our technique reduces this general existence question to finding an EF1 allocation satisfying a mild additional condition under a single finite-sized key laminar matroid, and we establish the required allocation by case analysis. We show that our technique somewhat extends to four agents, reducing the analogous problem to finding EF1 allocations under two finite-sized laminar matroids, although we are unable to establish their existence. We also use recent matroid decomposition results to establish EF1 existence under broader classes of matroids. Specifically, we show that EF1 allocations always exist under transversal matroids whenever a complete allocation is feasible, and obtain existence results for graphic matroids and gammoids under stronger assumptions.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 为什么在拟阵约束下公平分配不可分物品如此困难？尽管EF1（无妒忌至多一件物品）已被广泛接受为离散公平的标准，但在一般拟阵约束下其存在性仍是开放问题。现有工作仅解决了划分拟阵情形，而更复杂的结构如层状拟阵仍未被攻克。本文聚焦于这一理论缺口，探究在保持可行性的同时能否保证公平。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 作者考虑n个代理人对m个不可分物品的分配问题，每个代理具有加性估值，并需满足由层状拟阵定义的容量约束——即对某些物品子集限制每个代理人可获数量。目标是找到一个完整且可行的分配，使得无人严格偏好他人去掉某件物品后的束。模型强调约束的结构性质及其对公平解存在性的挑战。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文证明了三层状拟阵约束下总存在EF1分配，这是首个超越划分拟阵的结果。此外，利用拟阵分解技术，作者建立了横贯拟阵、图拟阵和伽莫伊德上的EF1存在性，其中横贯拟阵的结果完全解决了该类别的猜想。这些结果不仅扩展了已知边界，还揭示了不同拟阵类别间的结构性差异。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 核心方法是‘划分拟阵约减’：将复杂拟阵通过一系列保可行性操作简化为若干均匀拟阵与少量‘关键拟阵’的组合，再分别求解。对于三层情况，最终归约为一个含6个物品的关键实例并辅以序贯无妒忌条件。该技术结合了结构分解与案例分析，为后续推广提供清晰路径。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 当前方法难以直接扩展到四人以上，因关键拟阵规模增大导致构造性证明失败。此外，部分结果依赖强色彩性假设而非最理想条件。尽管如此，论文的价值在于提出了强有力的约减框架与新颖的技术路线，特别适合关注公平分配存在性、拟阵应用及算法构造的读者深入研读。

papers.title: Mechanism Design for Facility Location Games Under a Prelocated Facility
papers.titleZh: 基于预设设施的设施选址博弈中的机制设计
papers.abstract: We study the problem of locating a new homogeneous facility under a prelocated facility. Here, a set of $n$ agents is located on a real line or a circle, each of whom has her location as private information, and her cost is the (expected) distance from her location to the nearest facility. Our goal is to design mechanisms which can approximately minimize the maximum cost or the social cost while eliciting agents' private information truthfully (i.e., strategy-proof). Based on real-life scenarios, we consider the problem in two settings: the general setting where each agent can be located at both sides of the prelocated facility, and the special setting where all the agents are located at the same side of the prelocated facility. For agents on a line, in the general setting, we design the best possible deterministic strategy-proof mechanism with $2$-approximation and provide a lower bound of $1.5-ε\textbf{ }(ε>0)$ for any randomized strategy-proof mechanism under the maximum cost objective. For the social cost, we obtain an upper bound of $n$ for deterministic strategy-proof mechanisms and lower bounds of $1.5$ and $1.0425$ for any deterministic strategy-proof mechanism and any randomized strategy-proof mechanism, respectively. In the special setting, we further provide a randomized strategy-proof $5/3$-approximation mechanism for the maximum cost and a deterministic strategy-proof $(n-1)$-approximation mechanism for the social cost. For agents on a circle, we provide a deterministic strategy-proof 2-approximation mechanism under the maximum cost objective.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 为什么要在已有设施的基础上设计新设施的位置？现实中许多场景如学校、市场或服务点的增设都不能忽略已存在的资源。传统设施选址博弈通常从零开始布局，但本文关注的是如何在已有设施基础上新增一个同质设施，并激励居民真实报告位置信息。核心问题是：如何在不浪费既有设施的前提下，设计出既能逼近最优解又能防止策略性谎报的机制。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 模型考虑一组位于实线或圆上的代理，每个代理的成本是到最近设施（原有或新建）的距离。原有设施固定在0点，新设施由机制决定。代理私有其位置信息，机制需满足策略证明性——即无人可通过虚报位置获益。研究分两种设定：一般情形下代理可在原设施两侧分布，特殊情形下全在同一侧。目标是最小化最大成本或社会总成本，并引入‘改进比率’衡量机制利用新设施的实际效益。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文给出了多个紧的近似比界限。在线上一般设定中，提出了2-近似的确定性机制，并证明这是最优的；对随机化机制，在最大成本下建立了1.5−ε的下界。对于社会成本，确定性机制下界为1.5，随机化机制下界提升至1.0425。特别地，在代理全在一侧的特殊设定中，设计了一个5/3-近似的随机化机制。还提出了‘改进比率’这一新指标，并给出了相关上下界，揭示了机制实际改善能力的极限。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 作者通过构造具体的机制并分析其性能来证明上界，例如将新设施设在端点或按概率分布选址。下界证明采用反证法和实例构造，展示任何更好机制都会导致策略性操纵可能。关键技巧包括利用对称性简化情况、设计临界实例迫使机制行为暴露、以及通过期望成本比较推导矛盾。改进比率的分析则结合了最优解与机制输出之间的差距演化。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 论文的主要局限在于社会成本下的确定性机制近似比上界为n，与下界1.5之间仍有较大差距，尚未闭合。此外，模型假设所有代理使用相同类型的设施且偏好一致，未考虑异质性。尽管如此，本文在预设设施背景下的机制设计提供了清晰的新框架和分析工具，特别是‘改进比率’的概念极具启发性，适合关注机制设计理论、近似性分析及设施选址应用的研究者深入阅读。

papers.title: CHASE: How Content Ecosystems Are Reshaped When Ranking Is the Only Target
papers.titleZh: CHASE: 当排名成为唯一目标时内容生态系统的重塑
papers.abstract: Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) is increasingly used to improve content visibility in LLM-based retrieval systems, yet its population-level effects under repeated optimization remain poorly understood. We introduce Content Homogenization under rAnking Signal Exploitation (CHASE), a controlled simulation framework for studying how content ecosystems are reshaped when creators repeatedly adapt documents to an LLM ranking signal. We use ranking as a proxy for source visibility and validate this abstraction against citations in grounded generated responses, obtaining a rank-citation AUC of 0.853 $\pm$ 0.093 across six domains. CHASE then iterates ranking, feature discrimination, rewriting, and evaluation over 20 rounds across different domains. Quality-ranking alignment decreases in all six domains: from R0 to R20, the change in Spearman's rho ranges from -0.107 to -0.018, with a mean change of -0.068, which means documents closer to the ranking feature profile become less aligned with independently judged document quality over the simulation horizon. A random-target control has shown that it is associated with adaptation toward ranking-derived incentives rather than iterative rewriting alone. The resulting ecosystem dynamics are strongly domain-dependent. Together, these findings show how repeated optimization against a fixed LLM ranking signal can reshape both content populations and the incentives faced by content creators.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 随着生成式引擎优化（GEO）兴起，内容创作者不断调整文本以提升在LLM检索结果中的可见性。然而，这种反复优化对整体内容生态的长期影响尚不明确。本文关注的问题是：当所有创作者持续追逐同一固定排名信号时，内容质量与排名之间的关系是否会恶化，进而导致生态同质化或质量下降。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 作者构建了CHASE模拟框架，通过多轮迭代模拟内容生态演化。每轮包括四个阶段：由LLM对文档按查询进行排序，提取高排名文档的特征模式，部分低排名文档据此重写，最后评估整体生态变化。实验涵盖六个领域，使用不同模型家族分别负责排名、重写与质量评判，确保角色分离，评估跨度为20轮。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: CHASE揭示了一个核心现象：质量-排名背离——随着时间推移，越符合当前排名特征的文档，其独立评估的质量得分与这些特征的相关性反而下降。这表明优化方向逐渐偏离真实质量。同时，生态系统演变呈现显著领域差异，如结构趋同、信号不稳定或少数特征主导等模式。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: CHASE采用受控实验设计，利用可解释的判别器识别与排名相关的25维特征，并引导重写向‘赢家’特征靠拢。关键在于，它通过随机目标和无重写控制组，排除了单纯重写或重复评估带来的干扰，从而证实背离源于对排名激励的适应行为，而非机制本身的技术副作用。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 结论受限于20轮模拟、固定排名器及特定模型配置，未考虑真实系统中的反馈闭环与用户行为。此外，特征空间有限可能影响对质量下降的归因。尽管如此，该研究的价值在于提出了一个可复现的压力测试框架，其问题设定、动态观察与控制设计对理解生成式搜索下的内容演化极具启发意义。

papers.title: Learning to Evaluate Before Improving: Automatic Rubric Induction for Automatic Research Agents
papers.titleZh: 学会先评估再改进：面向自动科研智能体的自动评分标准归纳
papers.abstract: Autonomous scientific research agents are increasingly applied to end-to-end scientific workflows, including literature review, data analysis, experimentation, and report generation. However, open-ended research tasks often do not clearly specify the analyses, methods, and success criteria required to complete the task. As a result, agents may miss important analyses, use inappropriate methods, or draw conclusions that are insufficiently supported by evidence. To address the problem, we present AutoSciRub, an evaluation-first framework that induces a task-specific executable rubric before research execution, and uses it to guide execution, criterion-level verification as well as iterative revision. AutoSciRub decomposes an underspecified instruction into atomic scientific goals, grounds them in relevant literature and task-visible data, and synthesizes specific, actionable, and verifiable criteria. The resulting rubric makes implicit experimental and evidential requirements explicit, providing guidance for experiments and analyses. During revision, rubric-guided verification identifies unmet criteria and enables targeted refinement of the research report and its supporting artifacts. On ResearchClawBench, AutoSciRub consistently improves all tested configurations, with an average gain of 2.08 points across three backbone LLMs under the fixed Codex harness and 2.95 points across three agent harnesses using a fixed DeepSeek-V4-Flash backbone. On a randomly sampled 20-task subset of AstaBench E2E Discovery, AutoSciRub further achieves an average improvement of 16.8 points across three agent harnesses, while maintaining or increasing the number of successfully completed tasks. These results demonstrate that evaluation-first guidance provides an effective and generalizable control mechanism for autonomous scientific research (Code: https://github.com/zjunlp/AutoSciRub).

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 自主科研智能体常因开放性任务缺乏明确分析路径而遗漏关键步骤或得出无证据支持的结论。现有方法多依赖后验评估，无法在执行前明确科学目标与验证条件。本文指出，问题核心在于指令中的隐含需求未被显式化，导致智能体在规划阶段就偏离正确方向，亟需一种前置的、可执行的规范来引导全过程。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 研究在两个端到端科研基准上测试方法，输入为高层科研指令及可见环境（文献、数据、工具），输出为研究报告及其支撑材料。作者通过诱导生成任务特定的可执行评分标准，并用于指导执行与迭代修订。评价采用基于评分标准的细粒度打分，对比不同主干模型与智能体框架下的表现提升。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文提出AutoSciRub框架，首次实现从模糊指令中自动生成可落地的科研规范。实验显示其在多个模型与系统配置下均显著提分，在ResearchClawBench平均提升2–3分，在AstaBench更达16.8分，且不降低任务完成率。结果证明前置评估机制能有效提升科研智能体的严谨性与成果质量。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 方法分为两阶段：先将原始指令分解为原子科学目标，再结合相关文献检索、任务数据探查，合成具体的、可验证的执行标准。随后在生成报告后逐项核查标准满足情况，定位缺失并驱动定向修改。该机制使隐性科学实践显性化，形成‘评估—执行—再评估’的闭环优化。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 尽管评分标准提升了执行质量，但其科学核心覆盖依赖初始目标分解，若骨架错误则难以纠正。此外，额外推理步骤带来计算开销。最值得阅读的是其问题洞察与系统设计，展示了如何将人类科研规范转化为智能体可用的中间表示，对构建可信科研自动化系统具有启发意义。

papers.title: Hi-Q: Hierarchical Evidence-guided Query Refinement for Multi-Hop Question Answering
papers.titleZh: Hi-Q: 分层证据引导的查询细化用于多跳问答
papers.abstract: A central bottleneck in multi-hop Question Answering (QA) is that the granularity at which a question is expressed often differs from the granularity at which corpus evidence is retrievable. Existing methods address this mismatch by imposing fixed graph structures over the corpus, by iteratively reformulating the query, or by executing a generated program over it, but these strategies do not explicitly decide when a query unit is already supported by evidence and when it should be refined. We formulate this bottleneck as retrievable granularity discovery and introduce Hi-Q, an evidence-conditioned framework for hierarchical query refinement. At each query node, a resolution operator tests whether retrieved evidence supports the current query unit; resolved nodes terminate, while unresolved nodes are expanded by a dependency-preserving binary operator and checked by a semantic coverage verifier. Hi-Q therefore grows a query tree whose topology is determined by corpus support signals rather than by a fixed decomposition template or a pre-built graph. We evaluate Hi-Q on three multi-hop QA benchmarks, primarily under full-corpus retrieval, where dependent evidence must be located among open-domain distractors rather than within a small annotated pool. In this setting Hi-Q reaches 52.3 EM and 64.0 F1 averaged over the three benchmarks, ahead of the iterative retrieval baseline IRCoT by 15.1 EM / 18.2 F1 on that same average, and ahead of the graph-based RAG baseline PropRAG by 11.5 EM / 12.0 F1 on MuSiQue-full, without corpus-wide graph construction. In the restricted supporting/distractor setting used by prior work, Hi-Q likewise attains the best accuracy, with 57.9 EM and 69.3 F1 on average, ahead of PropRAG by 5.6 EM / 3.9 F1 and IRCoT by 13.7 EM / 15.8 F1. The project page is available at https://hi-q-project.github.io/.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 多跳问答的核心难题在于问题表达的粒度常与可检索证据的粒度不匹配。现有方法如固定图结构、迭代重写或程序执行，往往无法判断何时一个子问题已可被证据支持、何时需进一步拆解。这导致粗粒度查询干扰检索，细粒度拆分又可能丢失上下文，从而引发错误传播。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 论文在三个主流多跳问答数据集上评估，主要采用全语料库检索设定，即从开放域干扰项中定位依赖证据，而非仅在标注片段池内查找。输入为原始自然语言问题，输出为最终答案，系统通过动态构建查询树进行推理，并以精确匹配（EM）和F1作为核心评价指标。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文提出Hi-Q框架，在全语料库设定下显著超越图结构和迭代检索基线，平均提升达15.1 EM。其关键贡献是将‘可检索粒度发现’形式化为基于证据反馈的控制问题，并验证了动态、分层的查询细化比预设结构更有效，尤其在复杂推理链中表现稳健。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: Hi-Q在每个查询节点先测试当前问题是否已被检索证据支持，仅当未被支持时才进行二元分解。分解遵循依赖顺序，确保前置事实先于依赖问题求解，并通过语义覆盖验证防止拆分偏离原意。整个过程形成由证据信号驱动的查询树，而非依赖固定模板。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 方法依赖LLM模块的稳定性，且实验集中于英文维基类短答案任务，对循环依赖或多分支联合优化的问题建模不足。最值得读的是其问题设定与控制机制设计，它揭示了检索对齐的关键不在更多调用而在更明智的粒度决策，这对构建可靠智能体具启发意义。

papers.title: MULTI3IR: A Benchmark for Multi-perspective Multi-domain Multi-modal Information Retrieval
papers.titleZh: MULTI3IR：一种多视角、多领域、多模态信息检索的评测基准
papers.abstract: Information retrieval (IR) increasingly targets open-ended queries that admit diverse perspectives. Existing IR benchmarks, however, focus primarily on closed-ended queries, while even open-ended benchmarks largely consist of queries whose supporting documents span a single subject domain and modality. We introduce Multi$^3$IR, a benchmark that evaluates how well retrievers cover the multifaceted perspectives of open-ended queries across diverse domains and modalities. It comprises 104.9K Stack Exchange queries, each annotated with perspective descriptions that capture the query's implicit viewpoints. We further propose SPIN, a parameter- and label-efficient method that learns noise vectors to steer embeddings toward diverse yet meaningful semantic directions. Experiments show that existing multimodal retrievers suffer from single-perspective bias, while SPIN substantially improves perspective coverage on Multi$^3$IR and generalizes well to unseen open-ended IR benchmarks. The dataset and experimental code are available at https://github.com/seokwon99/Multi3IR.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 传统信息检索多关注单一答案的封闭式问题，但现实中的开放性问题往往涉及多个视角、领域和模态。现有基准大多局限于单领域文本数据，无法评估系统是否全面覆盖查询的多元信息需求。本文指出当前多模态检索器存在‘单视角偏见’，即倾向于返回主导视角的结果而忽略其他方面，这暴露了在综合性信息获取上的根本缺陷。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 论文构建了MULTI3IR基准，包含10.5万条来自StackExchange的开放性问题，每个问题标注多个视角，每个视角关联跨领域、跨模态的支持文档。任务是评估检索器能否覆盖所有视角的相关文档。通过人工验证确保视角多样性和文档专属支持，并在测试中使用硬匹配和基于大模型的软判断两种指标衡量覆盖能力。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文提出了MULTI3IR这一大规模多视角检索基准，并发现主流多模态检索器普遍存在单视角偏见。为此提出SPIN方法，仅需视角描述即可训练轻量噪声向量来引导查询嵌入多样化。实验证明SPIN显著提升视角覆盖率，优于依赖文档标注或多步推理的方法，且在外部基准上具备良好泛化能力。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: SPIN方法在冻结的检索模型中间层注入可学习的噪声向量，通过将这些扰动后的查询嵌入与视角描述对齐，使单一查询生成多个语义方向不同的表示。训练仅需视角文本，无需昂贵的文档级相关性标注。推理时采用轮询聚合多个排序列表，从而更全面地覆盖分散在不同知识源中的相关信息。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 局限在于视角数量固定，未建模动态调整；自动构建的数据可能存在LLM诱导偏差；且领域覆盖仍不均衡。最值得读的是其问题设定与数据构建流程，揭示了开放检索中‘全面性’的新挑战，为未来研究提供了高质量基准和高效训练范式，尤其适合关注检索多样性与评测可靠性的读者深入研读。

papers.title: Beyond Polarization: The Generative Constraint of Chain-of-Thought in Pointwise Reranking
papers.titleZh: 超越极化：思维链在逐点重排序中的生成约束
papers.abstract: In pointwise document reranking, Chain-of-Thought models typically underperform direct scoring models. While existing diagnostics attribute this to inferior classification, score polarization, or calibration breakdown, whether targeted training can bridge this gap remains unclear. Our empirical study first confirms that this gap is stable across scales up to 32B parameters, ruling out model and data capacity confounders. We then apply stress tests utilizing reinforcement learning, fine-grained supervision, and architectural decoupling to explicitly repair these deviations. Although these interventions improve classification accuracy and absolute scores, the relative ranking gap persists. These findings suggest that, within the pointwise scoring paradigm, routing continuous relevance semantics through discrete text constrains ranking signal resolution, revealing a bottleneck that is stable and difficult to overcome under current standard methods, rather than an easily resolvable training bias.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 在基于大语言模型的文档重排序任务中，尽管思维链（CoT）被广泛用于增强推理透明性，但在逐点评分范式下其性能常不如直接打分模型。已有研究将其归因于分类不准、分数极化或校准失效，但尚不清楚针对性训练能否真正弥合差距。本文探究这一差距是否源于更深层的生成机制限制，而非单纯训练偏差。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 研究在统一框架下比较两种逐点重排序方式：直接输出相关性判断（noCoT）与先生成推理链再判断（CoT）。使用Qwen系列从0.6B到32B参数模型及Llama-3.1-8B，在MS MARCO衍生数据上进行监督微调，并在BRIGHT、DL19/20等基准测试。评估指标为NDCG@10，关注相对排名性能差异。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文发现无论扩大模型规模、增加训练数据量或提升推理链质量，CoT始终落后于直接打分，差距稳定存在。三种压力测试——强化学习对齐分类边界、细粒度监督缓解极化、架构解耦分离生成与打分——虽改善了中间指标，但未能消除排名差距。这表明问题不在于训练策略，而可能是离散文本生成本身对信号分辨率的固有约束。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 作者通过三类干预验证假设：GRPO强化学习使CoT分类准确率匹敌noCoT；引入细粒度评分提供更密集监督；采用两阶段架构将推理生成与打分解耦。这些方法分别针对分类、极化与计算耦合问题，构成严密证据链。关键洞察来自‘Label-CoT-Label’探针实验，显示相同标签在经过推理链后得分显著衰减，揭示离散路径的信息瓶颈。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 研究局限于标准逐点范式，未探索改变注意力机制或使用连续回归头等替代方案。结论依赖特定模型族与任务类型，且未涵盖现实部署中的延迟与成本因素。然而，其实验设计严谨，挑战了简单归因于训练偏差的观点。最值得阅读的是其对‘离散文本作为信号瓶颈’的实证分析与机制讨论，为理解CoT在排序任务中的局限提供了深刻洞见。
